text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English states that \"The Federal Chancellery is responsible for the joint reporting procedure\" while Italian states that \"The Federal Chancellery regulates the co-reporting procedure\" (regola la procedura di corapporto).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The Federal Chancellery is responsible for the joint reporting procedure", "before": "Guidelines for Federal Council Affairs\nThe Federal Chancellery is responsible for the joint reporting procedure in accordance with Art. 15 para. 2 of the Government and Administration Organisation Act"}, "tgt": {"quote": "La Cancelleria federale regola la procedura di corapporto", "before": "La Cancelleria federale regola la procedura di corapporto conformemente all’articolo 15 capoverso 2 della legge sull’organizzazione del Governo e dell’Amministrazione (LOGA)."}, "severity": 0.6}]}
